description: "Love Works Wonders: A Novel" by Charlotte M. Brame is a romantic novel written in the late 19th century. The story centers around Miss Pauline Darrell, a beautiful and spirited young woman raised by her father among Bohemian artists, who is now thrust into the aristocratic world of her uncle, Sir Oswald Darrell.
